title: Point-Slope Form
text: Because we are given $$2$$ points, it's easiest to plug our values into point-slope form: $$y1-y2=m \left(x1-x2\right)$$

title: Solve for $$m$$.
text: Because we have $$17.80-11.20=m \left(130-20\right)$$, we can solve for $$m$$.

title: Substitute
text: Plug our $$m$$ and $$b$$ into $$C(x)=mx+b$$. $$b$$, the y-intercept, is the monthly flat fee.
